title: sdk(ts): add experimental Cost Model API client (estimate/explain) behind config flag
author: Henry Cho
description: Context: Console + Optimize are adopting the Standard Cost Model (SCM) service, and several internal tools/scripts (scenario sweeps, ad-hoc audits, support investigations) need a lightweight way to call the Cost Model API from Node/TS. This PR adds an EXPERIMENTAL Cost Model client surface to the TS SDK, gated behind an explicit config flag so we don’t accidentally make SCM part of the public/stable SDK contract yet. This is NOT used for billing/invoicing and is intended for internal tooling and early integration work only. What’s included: 1) New experimental client namespace: client.experimental.costModel.estimate() and client.experimental.costModel.explain() 2) SCM v1 request/response types (JSON) with minimal validation helpers (required fields, enums) 3) Version negotiation header wiring (default request: scm-v=1; explicit override supported) 4) Conservative defaults for timeouts/retries suitable for tooling (short timeout + limited retries) 5) Test coverage via nock fixtures + type tests to prevent accidental breaking changes. Gating: This surface is ONLY available when the SDK is instantiated with { experimental: { costModel: true } }. Otherwise accessing client.experimental.costModel throws a clear error. This avoids shipping an API that looks stable/official by default. Follow-ups: - Once Cost Model API conventions stabilize, we can decide whether to promote this to a stable namespace and publish formal docs. - If Optimize asks for bulk/multi-scenario endpoints, we should add a separate method rather than overloading estimate().
commits: feat(experimental): add CostModelClient with estimate/explain methods
types(cost-model): add SCM v1 request/response types and enums
chore(http): add per-request timeout + bounded retry policy for experimental endpoints
test(cost-model): add nock fixtures and type-level tests
docs: add internal-only note in README (experimental surface)
changed_files: src/http/request.ts (allow per-call timeout override for experimental usage)
conversation: Priya Natarajan (review): Please ensure this cannot be accidentally called in production apps by default. Also, confirm the version header behavior matches the platform conventions (acceptable/required). Henry Cho (author): Added hard gating: experimental.costModel is undefined unless experimental.costModel=true; accessing it throws with an explicit message. Also added X-Redwood-SCM-Version header defaulting to v1 and optional scmVersion override. Jordan Lee (review): Type names look like they’ll leak into stable surface if we re-export; keep them scoped under experimental. Also please add a test asserting we send the version header and that unsupported versions return a typed error. Henry Cho: Moved SCM types under src/experimental/costModel/types.ts only, no re-export from root index. Added nock test asserting header and added CostModelApiError with code mapping (UNSUPPORTED_VERSION vs INVALID_ARGUMENT). Chloe Martin (review): Can we keep retries conservative? Console has its own client; tooling should not hammer SCM. Also make sure we don’t log full request payloads (tenant-sensitive). Henry Cho: Retries capped at 1 retry for 5xx/429 with jitter; default timeout 2s. No request payload logging added; errors sanitize request by omitting workload.details fields. Nadia Rahman (review): Please clarify in README/CHANGELOG that this is not billing and not stable. Henry Cho: Added explicit disclaimer in README and CHANGELOG under Unreleased. Priya Natarajan: Approved. Jordan Lee: Approved after changes. Chloe Martin: Approved. Nadia Rahman: Approved.
